fonte: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (Report of the Chief of Engineers 1905)
legenda: January 1905: approval to extend the breakwater to at least 9,000 ft.
nota: 'With money to spare' e o 1899 → 1912 da voz ('for thirteen years') vêm do dossiê; o 1912 é o do USACE (ver s47).
narracao: The rock came from Santa Catalina Island. In January 1905, with money to spare, the Army got approval to extend the wall to at least nine thousand feet.
